groups.title: Commercial
groups.summary: New installations, retrofits, lighting, repairs and maintenance for offices, warehouses, retail, restaurants and hotels.
groups.intro: Based in Houston, Texas, Sterling Wiring Solutions offers a full range of commercial electrician services from new installations to renewable power solutions. No job is too big, too small, or too unique for us to tackle, and our electricians are some of the best in the business. Because we are members of both the National Fire Protection Association and the Texas Electrical Safety Association, our work always meets the highest safety standards in the business.
groups.imageAlt: An electrician in a yellow hard hat installing wiring

services.title: Complete Electrical Solutions
services.text: When we say that we do everything, we mean it. Need a service not listed here? Give us a call, and we will accommodate your company's electrical needs.

services.title: New Construction and Retrofits
services.text: Whether you want to construct new warehouses or a small boutique, we will ensure that your new facility has safe and reliable wiring. Most business owners prefer to renovate existing properties wherever possible, and we can retrofit your current facilities with new wiring and electrical fixtures.
points: New industrial complexes, retail outlets, restaurants, offices and hotels
We work with other companies and contractors to finish your job on budget and on schedule

services.title: Repairs and Maintenance
services.text: Electrical systems are designed for low maintenance, and they should work for years without any problems. But outlets, switches and even wires grow unreliable after decades of use. If your facility was built in the '70s or '80s and has not been upgraded since, your building probably needs electrical repairs.
points: Flickering lights and outlets that spark when you plug something in
Fraying wires that show no signs but still pose a fire hazard
Potential issues identified and fixed before they cause serious problems
Most repairs only take a few hours to complete

services.title: Communications Infrastructure
services.text: Electricity is only half of our business. If you are still using a dedicated T1 line or another slow connection, we can upgrade your facility with fiber optic cabling for far faster network speeds.
points: USB 3.0, HDMI and Ethernet wiring upgrades
Wireless networks installed and configured at speeds up to 2 Gbps

groups.title: Commercial Lighting
groups.summary: Interior and exterior lighting installed, retrofitted to LED and maintained, indoors and across a site.
groups.intro: Lights burn out, they waste electricity, and you cannot touch them without burning your hand. At Sterling Wiring Solutions we are dedicated to completely replacing all of Houston's outdated lighting infrastructure. Warehouses and offices need reliable lighting to create a safe work environment, and at 12 hours of use per day an incandescent bulb lasts about three months where an LED lasts about 11 years.
groups.imageAlt: A large warehouse interior lit by overhead fixtures

services.title: Types of Lighting We Do
services.text: Interior and exterior lighting across every kind of site in the Houston area.

services.title: LED Retrofits
services.text: The average incandescent light bulb uses about 75 watts of electricity, but the average LED bulb uses about 15 watts. Depending on your business, lighting accounts for 10 to 20 percent of your total energy needs.
points: Lighting retrofits are relatively cheap and simple compared to other energy efficiency retrofits
Most LED bulbs work right out of the box with your existing fixtures and switches
Switches and light fixtures only take a few minutes to install

services.title: Lighting Installations and Upgrades
services.text: We install both interior and exterior lighting fixtures with low wattage LED bulbs, and we offer a number of other services to further improve your facility.
points: UPS and generator backups provide power during blackouts
Motion sensors save energy while increasing security
Dimmers allow employees to select optimal light levels
Lighting connected to a renewable energy solution

services.title: Lighting Maintenance
services.text: We inspect your motion sensors, fixtures and switches to make sure everything is functioning properly, and keep a site lit for a safe work environment.

groups.title: Structured Cabling
groups.summary: Voice, data, fiber optics, networks, LANs and phone systems installed and upgraded.
groups.intro: If your business still uses 10-year-old networking equipment, we have a simple solution: a complete upgrade of your structured cabling. Although Sterling Wiring Solutions started as a Houston electrical contractor, we now offer a full range of structured cabling options. Our experts will inspect your current infrastructure and make recommendations based on your bandwidth needs, and many customers decide to upgrade their electrical and structured cabling at the same time to minimize costs.
groups.imageAlt: Blue network cables patched into a rack-mounted switch

services.title: Data
services.text: As you hire additional employees and upgrade your computers, you will quickly find that your aging network can no longer handle the increased load. To bring your LAN up to speed, we can install the following cables.
points: Cat 6 Ethernet is the gold standard for wired networks, and depending on your access points and adapters we can boost LAN speeds up to 10 Gbps

services.title: Voice Communications
services.text: We can install or upgrade telephone systems including private branch exchanges, giving you the flexibility to add, remove or edit extensions at will. We can also help you configure VoIP so you communicate over your internet connection instead of a dedicated telephone line.
points: You keep a phone number, with added flexibility and mobility

services.title: Wireless
services.text: Wired networks provide incredible speeds and reliability, but wireless networks are easier to install and expand. Because wireless speeds and signal strength have improved in recent years, we now offer wireless LAN installations.
points: Standards such as 802.11ac have largely bridged the gap with wired networks

services.title: Modern Connectivity
services.text: Copper telephone lines used to be sufficient for basic phone calls and browsing, but the day-to-day tasks added over the years need far more bandwidth.

groups.title: New Installation and Construction
groups.summary: Electrical and telecommunications design and installation for a facility built from the ground up.
groups.intro: Planning on building a new store or office building? Let Sterling Wiring Solutions handle all of your electrical and telecommunications wiring requirements. If you have already started the design process, we can work with the contractor or construction company of your choice to make sure the electrical design is up to code. Otherwise, we can help design a facility from the ground up.
groups.imageAlt: A worker running electrical wiring through a ceiling

services.title: Expert Consultations
services.text: An office building, hotel and department store might have the same square footage, but their electrical needs are vastly different. A Sterling electrician begins by asking project questions.
points: What is the new facility's square footage and layout?
What is the facility's primary purpose?
What are your current and anticipated electrical needs?

services.title: In-House Design and Installation
services.text: Sterling Wiring Solutions never outsources the design process to another company. Besides electrical and structured cabling, we handle everything related to your electrical system.
points: We pull the necessary permits before our design and build team begins

services.title: Why New Construction Costs Less
services.text: Electrical work is both cheaper and easier for new installations compared to retrofits for one simple reason: we can access the walls and ceiling before the drywall goes up, which makes working around plumbing and wall studs straightforward.
points: New electrical installations typically complete within one to two weeks, though construction times vary by project
We can influence the design to better place outlets, fixtures and switches
We make every effort to improve the new facility's energy efficiency

groups.title: Renovations and Remodels
groups.summary: An existing facility brought up to code, rewired, relit and fitted with current outlets and ports.
groups.intro: Need to update an existing facility? Sterling Wiring Solutions can bring your current property up to code while improving your building's safety and functionality. Whether you wish to simply run a new Ethernet cable from one room to another or need to completely replace your wiring, an electrical contractor will breathe fresh life back into your facility.
groups.imageAlt: Wires connected inside an open switch box

services.title: The Time to Upgrade
services.text: Because your building's electrical infrastructure will be virtually replaced, we can easily add new conduits to increase electrical capacity or Ethernet cables running from room to room. At a marginal cost increase, we can vastly improve your electrical and telecommunications infrastructure without significantly delaying the project.
points: New conduits to increase electrical capacity
Ethernet cabling run room to room
Campus, building, room and classroom control automation

services.title: Improved Functionality
services.text: None of these products were available 10 years ago and they are now relatively commonplace. We can install conduits and wall plates that accept any type of digital cable, so you can upgrade your networking infrastructure as new technologies emerge.

services.title: Safety First
services.text: If we notice an outlet sparking or a light switch that is no longer functioning, we will replace the faulty equipment to eliminate the fire hazard. All commercial renovations will meet your local building codes, which can mean rerouting wires or replacing fixtures.
points: Older facilities do not typically cost substantially more

services.title: A Fresh Look
services.text: There is no easier way to update your building's look than installing new lighting. Our LED fixtures look great while using less energy than conventional lights, and we can install designer switches and outlets.

groups.title: Industrial
groups.summary: Heavy industrial wiring, switchgear, grounding and plant electrical systems from concept to completion.
groups.intro: Sterling Wiring provides professional electrical and telecommunications services for industrial installations, handling all aspects from concept to completion. Our experienced technicians are committed to safely performing the job for all heavy industrial wiring projects, and the team is equipped to perform new installation, upgrade existing systems and perform general maintenance, including repairs, troubleshooting and diagnosing a problem.
groups.imageAlt: Electrical control gear inside an industrial plant

services.title: Industrial Electrical Services
services.text: The full range of industrial electrical work we take on in Houston and the surrounding areas.
points: Above ground and below ground wiring

services.title: Water and Waste Water Treatment Plants
services.text: A team of trained and certified technicians specializing in electrical design and installation for water treatment and water reclamation facilities. Call on us to service your current system or upgrade to a new installation.
points: Service of an existing system or a new installation

groups.title: Safety
groups.summary: Arc flash protection, tested PPE and an OSHA-led training program behind every job.
groups.intro: Safety is such a serious and important matter that the owners of Sterling Wiring Solutions have another business named Live Line Electrical Safety Services, which tests electrical personal protective equipment, sells it and trains in electrical safety. It contains the only PPE testing laboratory serving the Greater Houston area for 200 miles.
groups.imageAlt: An arc flash protection suit and hood

services.title: Safety Training and Practices
services.text: Our technicians are overseen and instructed by a Safety Manager who is an authorized OSHA trainer with extensive knowledge in both General 1910 and Construction 1926 industries. Every technician is required to obtain the following.
points: OSHA 1910.331-1910.335 and NFPA 70E electrical safety training

services.title: Arc Flash Safety
services.text: An arc flash is an extremely dangerous burst of electricity resulting from an electric arc, shooting out a broad spectrum of electromagnetic energy, plasma, fragments and other dangerous molten materials.
points: Light, an extremely violent burst that can be as harmful as staring into the sun and can cause lasting retinal damage
Heat, reaching as high as 35,000 degrees Fahrenheit, which is why a fully enclosed arc flash suit matters
Arc blast, where superheated air and vaporized solids expand from the fault at supersonic speeds, loud enough to cause permanent hearing damage

services.title: Where Arc Flashes Occur
services.text: Arc flashes can happen abruptly without notice, with or without the presence of an electrician, in any location where electricity is present, including residential, industrial and commercial buildings.
points: Even a moist spiderweb can conduct enough electricity for an arc flash to occur

services.title: Tested PPE
services.text: All of Sterling Wiring's PPE is tested and inspected in compliance with OSHA, and every job is overseen by an OSHA Certified Health and Safety Official to minimize safety hazards.
points: No employee uses outdated or non-compliant PPE
Experience Modification Rate worksheets and OSHA Form 300A records published on our site

about.title: Sterling: highest in quality.
text: Sterling Wiring Solutions has been serving customers across Greater Houston since 2002. With more than a decade of experience in the electrical and telecommunications industries, every Houston electrician we employ can handle any type of commercial wiring or cabling project.

You will never run across a Sterling Wiring Solutions electrician who does not provide exceptional work and calls it a day. We understand that good enough is never actually good enough, and our electricians will always strive for perfection. From the very first time you call us until our electricians screw the last outlet into place, we take pride in providing exceptional service for every client.

We are a member of both the Texas Electrical Safety Association and the National Fire Protection Association, and we are managed by an OSHA Certified Safety and Health Official. Every job meets the highest safety standards in the industry. Sterling Wiring Solutions is a small, family-owned business based in Pearland, and a certified woman and minority owned business.
about.imageAlt: An industrial electric motor and its wiring in a plant

values.title: Trained on every visit
values.text: Every Sterling Wiring Solutions electrician is trained to both identify and fix wiring issues on the same visit, saving time and money.

values.title: Credentialed on site
values.text: All of our electricians carry Transportation Worker Identification Credentials, a biometric ID that allows access to restricted areas in ports, factories and vessels, so you never have to worry about unauthorized users entering your facility.

values.title: Local codes by heart
values.text: Codes differ from county to county and between towns and cities. Our Houston area electricians know the local electrical codes, so wires are properly grounded, outlets sit at the correct height and your inspection passes.

faqs.q: Does my building need electrical repairs?
faqs.a: Electrical systems are designed for low maintenance and should work for years without any problems, but outlets, switches and even wires grow unreliable after decades of use. If your facility was built in the '70s or '80s and has not been upgraded since, it probably needs repairs. Some symptoms are obvious, like flickering lights and outlets that spark when you plug something in. Other problems such as fraying wires might not display any signs, but they still pose a fire hazard.

faqs.q: How long does a new electrical installation take?
faqs.a: We can typically complete new electrical installations within one to two weeks, but construction times may vary by project. Unlike a complete remodel, electrical maintenance and repair jobs can be as simple as replacing a defective transformer, and most repairs only take a few hours to complete.

faqs.q: Why is new construction cheaper than a retrofit?
faqs.a: Electrical work is both cheaper and easier for new installations for one simple reason: we can access the walls and ceiling before the drywall goes up, which makes working around plumbing and wall studs a breeze. New construction projects also allow us to influence the design to better place outlets, fixtures and switches.

faqs.q: How much can a lighting retrofit save?
faqs.a: The average incandescent light bulb uses about 75 watts of electricity, but the average LED bulb uses about 15 watts. Depending on your business, lighting accounts for 10 to 20 percent of your total energy needs. Lighting retrofits are relatively cheap and simple compared to other energy efficiency retrofits, and most LED bulbs work right out of the box with your existing fixtures and switches.

faqs.q: Why choose a licensed electrical contractor?
faqs.a: Maintaining a valid license is all about accountability. Not all unlicensed electricians will take your money and run; some will finish the job with makeshift repairs that will not last more than a year or two, and there are others that will do a good job. Unfortunately, there is no way to know what kind of job an unlicensed contractor will provide. We hold Texas Electrical Contractor License 27247 and have always maintained all of the necessary licenses in Houston.

faqs.q: Do you work around our business hours?
faqs.a: Yes. With flexible scheduling options, our electricians can work around your business hours to avoid any disruption to your operations.

faqs.q: Do you handle data and phone as well as electrical?
faqs.a: Electricity is only half of our business. We also specialize in data and phone system installations, which makes us a one-stop shop for everything related to wires, and many of our customers decide to upgrade their electrical and structured cabling at the same time to minimize costs.
